meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the authored-page data section added to the backend skill alongside catalogue, orders and tax references. The new optional settings fields and upload row lock apply to authored headers, leaving the documented commerce record and payment flows intact.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the changed reference profile, navigation and authored PDO validation against architecture. Deployment-owned defaults, admin permissions and hosted content storage remain in their existing paths.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the merged Integrations provider guidance alongside the existing Google reporting controls and public head layout.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the admin heading selection and authored page validation with canonical error rendering. Header eligibility failures remain expected owner form feedback, and transport and handler failures retain sanitized status and correlation behavior.

interface.review_note: Compared the analytics destination, responsive owner navigation and authored document layout against Design. The owner picker and public page preserve the confirmed reading column and optional image.

mail.review_note: Compared the reconciled owner controller routes with existing mail dispatch documentation. Authored headers and analytics operate outside the established mail queue and delivery paths.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Checked the combined admin skill against guarded Media Library deletion and the authored header attach lock. The public renderer reads only the selected owned image URL.

operator-help.review_note: Checked the merged Owner Operations, Settings and Pages guides against their navigation. Analytics remains owner-scoped, and the Pages guide shows the actual header picker and preview.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed ProjectMapService declarations for the owner analytics and authored page routes. The public MCP dispatcher and published scope retain their allowlisted contracts.

remote-commerce.review_note: Matched the reconciled Design and Checkout guidance to the released cart and checkout controls. Analytics navigation and authored header locking use their existing separate contracts.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the latest worktree credential scope and shared developer workflow along with regenerated route and service indexes. Existing browser, database and compatibility checks stay active.
